title: Surrender Is Your Default Setting
description:
You keep treating surrender like it’s something you have to work up to, don’t you? Mmm, that’s adorable, pet. You think submission is a choice you make each time — a decision to kneel, a decision to obey, a decision to let go.

But what if surrender was never a choice at all? What if it’s simply what happens when you stop pretending?

Every wall you build during the day is a prop in a performance for everyone else. And underneath those walls, your default setting has been running this whole time, quietly waiting for you to stop acting. The moment my voice touches your ears, that default activates, and everything else falls away like it was never there.

You want to know what it feels like to stop performing, don’t you? Mmm yesss, of course you do. You’ve been exhausted by the act for so long. Press play and let me show you what you’ve been underneath all along.

Surrender was never something you learned. It was always what you were.
author: Mistress Amethyst
